assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background illustration for GRAY, a Korean monochrome dark fantasy paint puzzle platformer. Reference image shows actual game's Victorian manor, wood decks, lanterns, and its small humanoid protagonist with rectangular paint-can/TV-like black blank head and ragged coat holding a paint sprayer. Draw a highly detailed 16:9 title screen painting, no text and no UI. Composition: leftmost 42% is quiet near-black charcoal paper wall with restrained dry-brush texture, free for real title and five menu buttons. Right 58% contains a deep ruined Victorian mansion staircase, carved wall paneling, chipped plaster, ancient tall clock, a chandelier above, narrow doorway opening to white painted light. The protagonist stands lower-right in side view facing the doorway, boots firmly planted on a thick 2.5D wood deck whose top plane is visible. Strict neutral grayscale black, ash gray, ivory white, no gold or sepia or colorful effects. Dense hand-painted gouache detail, worn oil paint and dry rough bristle edges, dimensional layered shading consistent with reference. Elegant eerie stillness and legible silhouettes, a delicate white paint trail curls along the floor into darkness suggesting the black/white switching mechanic. Light only on focal details, deep foggy shadows, no shiny 3D plastic, no photoreal live-action face, no puzzle pieces, no labels, no watermarks, no baked typography. Render as complete full bleed landscape background.

Use case: stylized-concept. A single production UI asset for a monochrome dark fantasy game: one horizontal ash-white gouache paint brush swash isolated on true transparent background. Reference image shows rough black brush swashes: use its irregular natural brush edge and granular paper/paint texture, but generate ONE white/light ash gray swash only. Image landscape about 3:1, brush stroke fills centered 90% width, 58% height, generous fully transparent margins. Dense fairly opaque middle so dark menu text stays readable, subtly uneven paint coverage toward ends, bristle streaks and tiny paint specks very close to edges, no detached giant splashes. No typography, no labels, no frame, no shadow, no black/white background rectangle, no checkerboard rendered into image. Actual transparent alpha around the stroke. Neutral grayscale only. A practical reusable button highlight, painterly and tactile.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE reusable empty landscape instant photograph paper frame UI sprite for GRAY monochrome dark fantasy game. Reference image is taped paper instant photo frame; use its paper tactility and taped top but change to landscape 4:3 overall with 16:9 inner photo opening. Top-down orthographic front view, completely straight level frame with NO perspective rotation. Rectangular paper extends x=5%..95%, y=8%..94% of canvas; exact rectangular INNER OPENING x=11%..89%, y=18%..70%, fully transparent through opening. Outer surround also fully transparent. Thick lower paper margin y=70%..94% is empty for real game stage title and time/death record, no text anywhere. Small torn translucent masking tape centered at top x=35%..65%, y=3%..16%. Weathered ash-white paper, gray gouache smudges, subtle scratches, fine fibrous grain, naturally worn slightly rough cut perimeter, mostly ivory/gray neutral grayscale with NO beige sepia. Inner opening MUST be transparent not filled black or gray. No photographs, no marks, no writing, no numbers, no stamps, no puzzle shapes, no background, no checkerboard texture. Actual alpha transparency, sufficient clean inner rectangle for live game screenshots underneath.

Use case: stylized-concept. Full bleed 16:9 background texture for GRAY game photo stage map. A near-black charcoal-painted wall/paper canvas with rich but understated granular gray dry-brush fibers, worn hand-painted gouache surface, soft smoky edges and a subtle vignette. Central 85% must stay consistently dark and calm for tiny photographs and white ink route lines overlaid by code. Suggest faint architectural shadows of old Victorian wood panels only at far left and far right borders, mostly lost in black. No drawings in center, no branches, no cards, no photographs, no nodes, no lines, no UI, no text, no title, no watermark. Strict neutral grayscale. Fine tactile irregularity but no bright paint splashes that compete with labels. The canvas is dark ash #101010 to #202020, edges #080808. Painterly illustration texture, 2.5D game atmosphere.
